title: SIR Remediation Trace Block
description: Closed format for the sir-trace block carried by each plan coordinate. Scenario-to-analysis edges are declared explicitly; independent analysisReferences and scenarioIds arrays are forbidden because their combination would require an inferred Cartesian product.

planReferences.description: Analysis coordinates this plan section cites, with the role each citation serves.

scenarioMappings.description: Explicit scenario-to-analysis edges. Each referenced analysis must also appear in planReferences.

role.description: authority: current implementation direction. guard: a constraint, including a rejected decision that bounds the work. context: explanatory only.
